title: FlightDelayAdvisor: Flight Disruption, Weather and Airport-Network Benchmarks
description: WITHDRAWN LOCAL RELEASE CANDIDATE, pending cutoff correction. FLARE-24 and BC-POT-R study three-state US domestic flight disruption prediction and airport-boundary context. A subsequent audit found that legacy prior-operating-day histories did not establish availability at each flight-specific T-24 cutoff; the old packaged smoke also reversed cancellation and conditional-delay arguments. Historical code, scores, negative results and evidence are retained for retrospective analysis, not as validated operational forecast performance. The corrected research path requires observation/source/label availability evidence and new matched temporal experiments. Corrected predictive performance has not been established.
notes: Do not publish this release candidate. The v3 withdrawal and required follow-up are recorded in manifests/failures/flare24_release_candidate_v3_withdrawn_cutoff_audit.json and docs/CUTOFF_RESEARCH_PLAN.md. 2025 is development-informed retrospective evidence, not blind confirmation. The historical +0.05 and +0.10 accuracy gates failed. The 2026 confirmation dataset was not opened, but incidental aggregate search exposure was recorded in docs/RESEARCH_CONTINUATION_20260905.md; no zero-exposure claim is made. Corrected real-data training stopped at the evidence gate. No external Zenodo deposit or DOI is claimed.
